question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Students, Players, Cricket players
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relation is as shown below :

 
• All Cricket players are players.
 
• Some Students are cricket players.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/010e535ce91db635aec4ff3dddfa8ad69d98a5809dfdf5472e47fa437dd04365.png]
